title: Cookbook:Oven-Roasted Potatoes

Baking: 30 minutes|difficulty=1 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Potatoes|Potatoes]]| [[Cookbook:Vegetables|Vegetables]] == Ingredients == * 2 large [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] * ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] * [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste * [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste == Procedure == # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|450°F]]. # Wash, peel if you like, and cut potatoes into wedges longways. # [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] in large bowl with olive oil. # Sprinkle with thyme. # Place potatoes in [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|baking pan]] in one layer. # [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] 15 minutes, turn, bake another 15 minutes.
